title: Superposition
blurb: Schrödinger's cat in a maze, dodging Observers. Tunnel through walls, split into a mirror twin, and if one of you is seen, collapse into the other.

title: Fowl Play: The Battle of Midair
blurb: A 1943-style vertical shooter. You're a bird. They're planes and flying cars. Splat what flies beside you, bomb what flies below.

title: Teron2
blurb: A remake of the Teron Gorefiend ghost-construct trainer from WoW's Black Temple, in 2D and 3D.
